<string name="ai_access_intro">Ask Claude, ChatGPT or another AI app about your spending, or open the dashboard on a computer. They can read your transactions, balances and subscriptions only while an AI session is on, and change nothing unless you allow it below.</string>

<string name="ai_access_allow_changes_body">Connected apps can create categories and rules, set a merchant\'s category or display name, and re-file a merchant\'s past transactions. They can\'t delete transactions or edit amounts.</string>

<string name="ai_access_privacy">Your data stays on your phone. During an AI session, the AI app\'s questions pass through the relay to your phone and the answers go back the same way. The relay never stores or logs them. The AI app\'s provider (for example Anthropic or OpenAI) sees the answers it receives.\n\nConnected apps can search your whole history across all profiles, including payee names on transfers. They never get SMS text, full account numbers or reference numbers. They can only change data while Let AI apps make changes is on.</string>
<string name="budget_edit_resets_last_working_day">Resets on the last working day of every month</string>
<string name="background_access_settings_subtitle">Stop Android from pausing your bank SMS tracking</string>
<string name="background_access_intro">Android stops apps that run in the background, and then your bank transactions stop arriving.</string>
<string name="background_access_all_set">All set. PennyWise can keep tracking your bank messages in the background.</string>
<string name="background_access_battery_why">Stops Android from putting PennyWise to sleep, so your bank transactions arrive on time. Find PennyWise in the list and choose Don\'t optimize.</string>
<string name="background_access_activity_why">PennyWise is set to Restricted. Open its battery settings and choose Unrestricted.</string>

<string name="background_access_keep_why">Turn off \"Pause app activity if unused\" or \"Remove permissions if app is unused\". Otherwise Android takes back PennyWise\'s SMS access after a few months.</string>
<string name="background_access_oem_howto_samsung">Prefer not to allow the battery step? Samsung can put PennyWise to sleep, so open this list, tap Add apps and pick PennyWise.</string>
<string name="background_access_oem_howto_xiaomi">Turn on Autostart for PennyWise. Path: Settings → Apps → Permissions → Background autostart.</string>

<string name="background_access_oem_howto_huawei">For PennyWise, turn off Manage automatically, then turn on Auto-launch, Secondary launch and Run in background. Path: Settings → Battery → App launch.</string>
<string name="background_access_oem_howto_coloros">Turn on Allow auto launch and Allow background activity for PennyWise. Not on the screen that opens? Look in App info → Battery usage.</string>
<string name="background_access_oem_howto_vivo">Turn on Autostart for PennyWise, then allow it in Settings → Battery → Background power consumption management.</string>
<string name="background_access_oem_howto_transsion">Allow PennyWise under Auto-start in the Phone Master app.</string>
<string name="background_access_oem_howto_asus">Allow PennyWise under Auto-start Manager in the Mobile Manager app.</string>
<string name="background_access_oem_howto_other">Some phones have their own background controls. In App info, turn on anything like Auto launch or Run in background for PennyWise.</string>
<string name="bill_reminder_channel_description">A heads-up the day before a subscription or bill is due</string>
<string name="conscience_settings_subtitle">Silent, cheeky comments on food, fun and shopping.</string>

<string name="conscience_confirm_dislike">Got it. That one\'s retired for good 🫡</string>
<string name="conscience_channel_description">Occasional cheeky comments on food, entertainment and shopping. Silent.</string>

<string name="money_alert_channel_description">When a budget runs high or an account balance falls low</string>
<string name="settings_budget_alerts_subtitle">Warns at %1$d%% early in a period, and when you go over</string>

<string name="review_banner_year_subtitle">Where the year went, from what you recorded</string>
<string name="share_text_suffix">It reads bank SMS on your phone, and nothing gets uploaded. https://%1$s</string>

<string name="notif_weekly_channel_description">A short recap of last week\'s spending</string>
<string name="permission_privacy_points">• Reads only bank SMS. Never sends any.\n• No account. Data stays on your phone.\n• Open source. Turn off anytime in Settings.</string>
<string name="sms_access_card_body">PennyWise finds your spending in bank SMS. Without access, bank SMS aren\'t tracked.</string>
<string name="sms_access_empty_body">They\'ll show up here once SMS access is on.</string>
<string name="sms_access_blocked_hint">Android won\'t ask again. Allow SMS in app settings.</string>

<string name="chat_action_check_amount">Check the amount: I didn\'t see this number in your message. Tick to add it.</string>
<string name="chat_action_check_not_paid">This may not be a payment you made. Tick to add it.</string>

<string name="chat_welcome">Hi! I'm PennyWise AI.

Tell me what you spent and I'll add it after you confirm — e.g. "coffee 120 at Starbucks" or "got 50000 salary". Ask "how much on groceries this month?" for a total.

Nothing is saved without your tap.</string>
<string name="chat_error_message_too_long">That message is too long for the AI. Try a shorter one.</string>

<string name="settings_tracked_apps_body">Pick the apps that notify you about payments. Their notifications show up in Unrecognized SMS as suggestions, and nothing is added until you tap Add. Supported bank apps are read already and aren\'t listed.</string>
<string name="settings_tracking_intro">PennyWise reads bank messages and notifications right on this phone to add transactions for you.</string>
<string name="settings_accounts_categories_intro">Choose which accounts are tracked and how transactions get sorted.</string>
<string name="settings_planning_intro">Set limits and see what\'s coming up. The budget cycle also sets the period Home and Analytics show.</string>

<string name="settings_currency_intro">Every transaction keeps its original currency. Your default currency is used for totals and conversions, and Unified mode shows everything in one currency.</string>
<string name="settings_formats_intro">Choose how text, amounts and dates appear across the app.</string>
<string name="settings_notifications_intro">Choose what PennyWise tells you about. Each alert type can also be silenced on its own in system settings.</string>
<string name="settings_security_intro">Keep your finances private when someone else has your phone.</string>
<string name="settings_data_intro">Your data lives only on this phone, so back it up before you switch or reset your device.</string>
<string name="settings_ai_intro">AI chat runs entirely on your phone. Connected AI apps can read your data only while you allow it.</string>
<string name="settings_developer_intro">Tools for technical users. Webhooks send the data you select to a server you choose.</string>
<string name="settings_subscriptions_subtitle">Bills and plans that renew on their own</string>
<string name="settings_notification_types_subtitle">Turn each kind of alert on or off in system settings</string>

<string name="learned_categories_intro">When you change a transaction\'s category, PennyWise remembers it for that merchant and uses it for new transactions. Remove one to stop that. Past transactions keep their category.</string>
<string name="learned_categories_empty">Nothing learned yet. Categories you pick for a merchant show up here.</string>
